body:
HOW TO CUT THIS ITEM, IN WHAT ORDER (task text and register read 6 Nov 2026, main e394d03; the git facts were measured).

IT IS FOUR PULL REQUESTS, NOT ONE. The definition lists about 17 fixes in four areas and contradicts itself on size (title and board say L, the body says "Size. M"). Cut it so each has the test that fails first:
 1. THE LOCK (B-10, B-18, B-19), first, and before P3-31. The fix exists: branch `held/server-db-lock` (on origin), one commit `0723bba`: api.py +82/-31, db.py, `tests/test_db_lock.py` (9 tests) and `tests/bench/bench_users.py` (the 20-phone load test the acceptance names). It is 32 commits behind main and ahead by 1, and a dry-run merge into e394d03 is CLEAN today (`git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main origin/held/server-db-lock` makes a tree, no conflicts). It edits the same file P3-31 will split, so every day it waits it can conflict, and the split would turn its hunks into a hand rebase. Rebase it, run the load test, merge, THEN split. The rule it enforces goes into docs/30 section 5 as a machine-checked ratchet if one can be written: no network call inside `db.tx()` (a test that fails when `urlopen`/`requests` is called while a transaction is open).
 2. THE DOORS (B-41, a non-ASCII `?sig=` is a 500, the reset link that unlocks, 403 mapped to "sign in again" for a member): all in auth.py/accounts.py/api.py, all provable with `audit_stack.py check outage` and `check badsig` (they print PASS when fixed). B-41 first: `NavidromeVerifier.verify` (auth.py:67-100) must return three answers; the sign-in route (api.py:165-168, 336-339) must not count the third.
 3. THE SOURCE (concurrent refusals escalate the rest: sources/youtube/rest.py:49-54; `classify_failure` tests the substring "age": errors.py:23; stream caches never evict; `YT_FAST_CLIENTS` is documented and does not exist: the three hard-coded `visionos` places; B-43 canary environment): tests/sources/ has test_rest.py and test_stream.py to extend. Decide `YT_FAST_CLIENTS` openly: build it or take the sentence out of the documents.
 4. THE LIMITS AND DOCUMENTS (6 GB at install against 10 GB in the keeper, B-42; the pace ceiling; the websocket reads before it authenticates; `__version__` is 0.1.0 in every build): mostly the installer and docs/22; the websocket one needs a test with an oversized first frame.

DOCS THAT ARE ALREADY CORRECTED (#186): docs/17 section 1 and docs/18 now say `Idempotency-Key` is a target and the table unused. Decide inside this item: build it (the app makes ids for creates, so most writes are safe without it) or drop the table in migration 0010 and take the row out. Do not leave it in between a third time.

ACCEPTANCE: the 20-phone numbers in the task (p95 at most 135 ms, worst at most 200 ms) are measured by `bench_users.py`, which exists only on the held branch: it must be merged with the lock fix or the acceptance cannot be repeated. Put the numbers and the setup in the PR (AGENTS.md: measure what you claim).
